intro: Run an exact conversion of cubic feet to gallons for swimming pools, water storage tanks, aquariums, rain barrels, and plumbing sizing. Because 1 cubic foot equals 1,728 cubic inches and 1 US liquid gallon is defined as exactly 231 cubic inches, 1 cubic foot of water holds 7.48052 US gallons (and 1 US gallon equals 0.13368 cubic feet). Multiply ft³ by 7.48051948, or look up capacities from 0.5 ft³ to 1,000 ft³ below.

mistakesAndEdgeCases.title: US vs. Imperial Gallons, Flow Rates (CFS to GPM) & Propane Vapor
items: This converter outputs US liquid gallons (1 ft³ = 7.48052 US gal). Because a British Imperial gallon is 20.1% larger (4.54609 L vs. 3.78541 L), 1 cubic foot equals only 6.22884 UK Imperial gallons.

Do not confuse static volume (cubic feet) with flow rate (CFS, cubic feet per second). To convert CFS to US gallons per second, multiply by 7.48052; to convert CFS to US gallons per minute (GPM), multiply by 448.83117 (7.48051948 × 60).

For liquefied gases like propane, distinguish liquid volume from vapor volume: 1 US gallon of liquid propane occupies 0.13368 ft³ inside a tank, but expands roughly 270× into about 36.39 ft³ of gas vapor at standard atmospheric pressure (60 °F, 14.7 psi).

faqs.question: How many cubic feet of water are in a gallon?
faqs.answer: One US liquid gallon of water equals 0.13368 cubic feet (231 ÷ 1,728 ft³ exact). Conversely, 1 cubic foot of water holds 7.48052 US gallons (weighing roughly 62.43 lb at room temperature).

faqs.question: How many cubic feet is a gallon?
faqs.answer: Geometrically, 1 US liquid gallon equals 0.13368 cubic feet (231 cubic inches) for any liquid. A British Imperial gallon is larger at 0.16054 cubic feet.

faqs.question: How many cubic feet are in a gallon of propane?
faqs.answer: As a liquid inside a tank, 1 US gallon of liquid propane occupies 0.13368 cubic feet (about 4.2 lb). When released and vaporized into propane gas at standard atmospheric pressure (60 °F, 14.7 psi), 1 liquid gallon expands about 270× into roughly 36.39 cubic feet of vapor.

faqs.question: How do I convert cubic feet to gallons?
faqs.answer: Multiply cubic feet by 7.48051948 (1,728 ÷ 231): gal (US) = ft³ × 7.48051948. For example, 100 ft³ × 7.48051948 = 748.05 US gallons.
